source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Front Suspension, p.3-4

procedures.title: Caster and camber: adjust
parts: upper control arm inner support shaft
steps: Lift the front bumper and let it drop quickly so the car settles at its normal height before checking caster and camber.
notes: On Corvette (and Chevelle, Camaro, Chevy II) caster and camber are set with shims; details continue on the next page.
See figure 4 in the manual for the Corvette front suspension layout and figure 5 for a diagram of the caster and camber angles relative to vertical.
